# Official OKF Fixtures

These fixtures are copied from the Apache-2.0 licensed Google Cloud
`GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog` repository:

- Source repository: https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog

- License: `LICENSE.md` in this directory

They are used to verify lenient OKF v0.1 conformance against real sample bundles.
